topic.readerProblem: Buyers choosing between a free instant AI-visibility audit and Profound's sales-led monitoring platform need to know which job each tool does, what Profound's brand plans actually cost today, and where a one-off audit falls short.
topic.connection: AEOeye's free ChatGPT check and $29 one-time five-engine report serve the baseline job; the page says plainly where Profound's continuous tracking, history and enterprise controls are stronger and routes readers to monitors when that is the need.

assessment: The page replaces an outdated comparison (free 'multi-engine' audit, old $99/$399 Profound tiers, 'no free trial') with Profound's current public pricing: a free 7-day Trial and a custom Enterprise plan for brands, and a $99/month Agency Growth plan with $399/month client workspaces. It states the free AEOeye audit is ChatGPT-only and the $29 report adds four engines, uses SparkToro's 2,961-run study to explain why a single audit is a snapshot, and adds a neutral fact box from AEOeye's crawler access study. It does not claim hands-on use of Profound, rank the products on quality, or state anything about Profound's Enterprise price.

sources.supports: Brands tab: free Trial (50 unique prompts daily for 7 days, ChatGPT/Gemini/Google AI Overviews, limited AI Marketer credits, no history/exports/API, fixed recommended prompt set) and custom Enterprise (up to 9 engines, all-time history, CSV/JSON, API, SSO/SAML, SOC 2, ChatGPT Shopping); agencies tab: Agency Growth $99/month plus add-ons, +1 client workspace $399/month; 'Is Profound only for AI search?' FAQ answered No.
Agent Analytics tracks AI crawler visibility and attribution of AI-driven traffic; page states Profound is SOC 2 Type II certified.
Answer Engine Insights covers prompt tracking, citation tracking, sentiment and FactCheck (inaccurate claims about a brand).

600 volunteers ran 12 prompts through ChatGPT, Claude and Google AI 2,961 times; under 1 in 100 chance ChatGPT or Google's AI repeats the same brand list; author concludes visibility % across 60-100 repeated runs is the reasonable metric.
Definition of generative engine optimization / answer engine optimization.
